FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 66
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/26/2024
Senate Bill 66 as passed the Senate would make the following supplemental appropriations for
fiscal year 2024:
1) $2,243,062 from the Youth Services Reimbursement Fund to the Department of Youth
Services;
2) $300,000 from the Veterans' Assistance Fund to the Department of Veterans' Affairs; and
3) $215,427,369 from the State General Fund to various agencies and entities.

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 66
Committee: ENACTED Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 06/07/2024
Senate Bill 66 (Act 2024-412) as enacted makes the following supplemental appropriations for
fiscal year 2024:
1) $2,243,062 from the Youth Services Reimbursement Fund to the Department of Youth
Services;
2) $7,300,000 from the Veterans' Assistance Fund to the Department of Veterans' Affairs; and
3) $254,125,169 from the State General Fund to various agencies and entities of the state for the
purposes specified.
